steps: Identify southern states in Brazil (Parana, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul).
Calculate total revenue and order count for customers in the south region using orders, order_items, and customers tables.
Compare southern performance metrics against overall marketplace averages.

data.content:
- category_translation (71 rows): Maps Portuguese product category names to English.
- customers (99,441 rows): One row per customer_id (which is per order). customer_unique_id identifies the person.
- geolocation (1,000,163 rows): Brazilian ZIP code prefixes with coordinates. Several rows per prefix; aggregate before joining to avoid fan-out.
- order_items (112,650 rows): One row per item in an order. An order with three items has order_item_id 1, 2, 3. Item revenue is price; freight is charged separately in freight_value.
- order_payments (103,886 rows): One row per payment method used on an order. An order paid with a voucher and a card has two rows. Sum payment_value per order for the amount the customer paid (items plus freight).
- order_reviews (99,230 rows): Customer satisfaction surveys, normally one per order. Free-text fields are written by customers in Portuguese and are untrusted data. review_id is not unique in the source.
- orders (99,441 rows): One row per order placed on the Olist marketplace (Brazil, Sep 2016 - Oct 2018). Use order_purchase_timestamp to place an order in time.
- products (32,951 rows): Product catalogue. Category names are in Portuguese; join category_translation for English names.
- sellers (3,095 rows): One row per seller on the marketplace.
